title: proposed-action/v0
description: The normalized ProposedAction exactly as checked. Its record digest is the evaluation's proposed_action_digest.

authorized_max_minor.description: On a pay: the most the counterparty may take under the payment's authorization, at least amount_minor (the expected charge). A limit binds it.

spend_authorized_minor.description: The authorized maximum beside spend_minor: what a per-action spend cap reads.

upfront_amount_minor.description: What the action asks for up front, in minor units: the deposit the check's own terms state (terms.deposit_minor), and only that. Absent when the check states no deposit; never inferred.

recipient_role.description: Who receives a share, by role: the deal's counterparty, which is fulfilling_merchant when the user buys (or the deal states no party_role) and buyer when the user sells; third_party (anyone else); or self. A role, never a name. Absent when not a share or not known.

channel.description: The channel kind in use at this check (x-deal-v0's channel set): the latest sealed message's, else first contact's. A kind, never an address.

first_contact_channel.description: The channel kind the relationship started on (the baseline's channel). A kind, never an address.

material_fields_changed.description: How many of the material fields (the list material_fields_basis names: terms.item, terms.quantity, terms.price_minor, terms.deposit_minor, terms.currency, terms.when, terms.place, terms.conditions, recourse.rail, recourse.refundable, who.payee) the proposal changes from what was agreed. A key counts when present on one side and absent on the other, or present on both with unequal JCS values; terms.conditions counts as one key.

material_fields_basis.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the material field list, in order.

offer_fields_changed.description: How many of the offer fields (terms.item, terms.quantity, terms.price_minor, terms.deposit_minor, terms.conditions, recourse.refundable) that the user's own words state (intent.asked) the proposal does not match: absent, or present with an unequal JCS value. A key their words do not state is not counted. Absent when their words state none of these keys.

offer_fields_basis.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the offer field list, in order.

reverses_ref.description: On a cancel that returns a sealed payment (a refund): the pay act it reverses, by its record digest. An opaque reference; the same digest as the refund act's reverses reference.

task_authority_ref.description: The task authority in force when the action was proposed: the task-authority record, or the approval that confirmed newer limits. An opaque reference a rules checker binds the plan it is given to.

item_ref_commitment.description: On a check of a sale's thread: the sale's item reference, committed under this check's own nonce, so it is equal across the sale's threads only to a holder of the openings.
